svg.title: Eureka by ALLEN, a product teardown. A brilliant learning idea hiding behind too much friction. Eureka is an active learning system for Class 10 board prep that replaces passive lectures and rote memorisation with animated storytelling, interactive prompts and guided problem solving, so understanding feels more like following a narrative than attending a class. Core question: can users discover Eureka's magic before they hit friction? Built from a 7 slide visual teardown and a 1 page written report. An illustrated phone screen shows the proposed language picker at onboarding, cycling through English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi and Bengali.
